source_fields.source_dataset_release: Digital Typhoon Dataset; exact local release/version not verified
source_fields.source_agency: Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA) RSMC Tokyo best-track-derived
source_fields.source_semantics_note: Repository metadata schema and HDF5 filename pattern match the Digital Typhoon Dataset. Digital Typhoon documents maximum wind in knots; its source best-track is JMA-derived, and JMA uses 10-minute maximum sustained wind. The 10 m reference height is used as the standard surface-wind modeling reference; the dataset metadata inspected does not explicitly state measurement height. Exact local Digital Typhoon release/version remains unverified.
source_fields.pressure_unit_note: Digital Typhoon/JMA central pressure is expressed in hPa; pressure is not used by the current wind-profile implementation.
source_fields.wind_availability_note: Digital Typhoon/JMA maximum sustained wind is recorded for grades 3 (tropical storm), 4 (severe tropical storm), and 5 (typhoon). Grade 2 (tropical depression) and grade 6 (extratropical cyclone) have no applicable maximum sustained wind value; zero placeholders in these grades are treated as unavailable and are excluded before applying any wind adjustment.

wind_adjustment.note: Add the configured offset only to finite numeric source wind observations whose grade is in source_fields.eligible_grade_values (3, 4, 5). Grade 2 and 6 wind placeholders are treated as unavailable. Preserve original values; missing and ineligible observations remain missing. This is an experimental offset, not a physical correction or calibrated bias adjustment.

rmw.note: No verified RMW field is available in the normalized track table. 30 km is a sensitivity assumption, not an observed or calibrated radius.

surface_wind_note: Use the source sustained wind value as the radial profile Vmax only after confirming that it represents a 10-m sustained wind. No conversion between 1-min, 3-min, or 10-min averaging periods is applied.
